value.rationale: A natural three-parameter projective Hibi family has an exact, sharp reductive/nonreductive threshold at a singleton intermediate antichain. Its root system changes from a product of a+b semisimple rank-one systems to only a+b commuting unipotent roots, and increasing variety dimension can lower automorphism dimension. This is a motivated structural symmetry classification, not merely a small numerical table.
